_note: Human-curated SEED knowledge for the reverse trace (levels 7->1). Not inferred by the agent. Must be reviewed by a domain expert before any use beyond demos.

chain.7_body: reduce joint pain/inflammation without global immunosuppression
chain.6_organ_system: dampen autoimmune activity in the musculoskeletal/immune axis
chain.4_tissue: lower inflammatory cytokine signalling (e.g. IL-6, IFN-gamma) in synovial tissue
chain.3_cell: JAK-STAT signalling in synovial fibroblasts and T cells

rheumatoid arthritis.anti_target_rationale: JAK2 mediates EPO/TPO/GM-CSF signalling (haematopoiesis); sparing it is a common selectivity goal.
